links.outcome: Accuracy and temporal stability of per-patient risk trajectories across six early event prediction tasks
links.effect: Existing methods, especially LLMs, struggle to jointly optimize accuracy and stability, with notably poor recall at high-precision operating points.
links.quote: Across tasks, existing methods, especially LLMs, struggle to jointly optimize accuracy and stability, with notably poor recall at high-precision operating points.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating temporal stability of patient risk trajectories using a local-Lipschitz-based stability metric alongside accuracy in early event prediction benchmarks

screen.reason: Introduces CAREBench to benchmark clinical time-series predictive risk models and LLMs specifically on temporal stability of risk trajectory metrics.
